article.title: Куриная печень для мусса: почему внешний вид не заменяет измерение температуры
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 1 журнальной странице: все 6 абзацев расследования, благодарности, сведения об авторах и организации, данные для переписки и заявление о конфликте интересов. Все 5 библиографических записей сохранены на языке оригинала. В источнике нет отдельной аннотации, рисунков и таблиц. Текст подготовлен по полному XML PMC и сверён с PDF издателя. Подзаголовки добавлены для навигации; редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.license: Public domain, explicitly stated in article-specific PMC XML license paragraph and MMWR policy. XML also carries a CC BY 3.0 text-mining reference.
source.rights_note: Attribution, free-source link and nonendorsement notice supplied. Publisher PDF bytes preserved. Translation, added navigation subheadings and separate editorial explanations identified; no CDC logo introduced.
source.status_check: Publisher page has no correction notice; Crossref has no update-to relation and XML has no retracted-article relation. Targeted DOI correction search and PubMed did not reveal a correction.

selection.reader: Food safety, HACCP, technology and kitchen staff working with poultry and offal.
selection.utility: Separates visual assessment of cooking from a measured demonstration temperature, epidemiologic associations and PFGE evidence from a different outbreak. Shows the value of investigating illness complaints.
selection.limits: Historical Washington outbreak in July 2016; source published September 29, 2017. Five cases and fourteen controls, two foods associated with illness, very wide confidence intervals. July 15 demonstration was nine days after the July 6 meal. No original-batch food remained for testing. One patient isolate matched profiles from two liver samples from 2014; this is not a positive test of the 2016 lot. The 77% figure is from a separately cited 2012 study, not this outbreak or current Russian products. Regulatory and surveillance descriptions are historical US context.

review.arithmetic: Three confirmed plus two probable = five cases; four guests plus one worker = five. July 15 demonstration occurred nine days after July 6 meal. Fahrenheit/Celsius pairs are whole-degree rounded conversions preserved from source. Exposure cell counts are not reported, so ORs and CIs are preserved, not independently recalculated.
review.spelled_numbers: Initial complaint four of seven people from five households. Three positive stool cultures, five cases, fourteen controls and twenty-eight menu items. One patient isolate compared to two food samples from the 2014 outbreak. Same supplier is not a positive test of the missing 2016 batch. Second published Pacific Northwest outbreak and first US initial complaint-system report are historical author statements.
review.pdf_visual_review: All four pages inspected. Source text, author details, references and attribution legible; separate introductory page for editorial notes.

typesafe.mode: Additional review for coverage; full source comparison retained. No efficiency claim.
typesafe.manual_review: All four accepted source/translation pairs and the negative control assessed manually: case categories, both implicated foods and odds ratios, demonstration timing, external 77% citation and 2014-vs-2016 sampling distinctions retained. No automatic acceptance from model labels.
